## What is OpenClaw

OpenClaw is a self-hosted AI assistant platform that connects large language models (Claude, GPT-4, Grok, local Ollama models) to real tools: Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, email, calendar, web search, file system, cron scheduling, and MCP servers. It runs on any Linux VPS and gives users a persistent, private AI agent with memory.

## Key Capabilities

- Multi-model routing (Claude, GPT, Grok, local LLMs via Ollama)
- Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp messaging integration
- Cron scheduling and heartbeat automation
- MCP tool protocol support
- Memory system (daily notes + long-term MEMORY.md)
- Skills system for reusable workflows
- n8n integration for external automation

## Recommended VPS

Hostinger VPS (from $4.99/month) is the most common setup. OpenClaw installs in under 5 minutes on Ubuntu 22.04.
